findings.what: The UP tests at the morning reads use tools/uptest.py 'save', which runs 'python -m kaggle competitions leaderboard -d' through subprocess.run with NO timeout. After a standby the CLI has hung on network calls before (28 Sep 15:00-15:40Z), and a hang would block the session at a decision step (the exp89p read ~07:50Z; exp75/exp89r ~09:05-09:35Z). Freeze (7) requires every Kaggle call to be wrapped in a timeout. Each save is also one extra Kaggle call, while the e10 loop already downloads the full LB every ~30 min until 12:00Z. UP validity does not depend on snapshot spacing, because public bests never fall. A team above us in S0 and below us in S1 therefore proves our best rose.

findings.what: Post-wake (06:07Z): experiments/lb_poll/lb_poll.py sleeps with time.sleep(600) (l.35). On Windows 8 and later, timed waits need not count time spent in low-power states, so after the 05:10-06:00Z standby the poller may finish its remaining countdown before the next poll. It may also hit the 180 s CLI timeout on a cold network. The first post-wake header can therefore lag the wake by up to ~10-13 min. At 06:07Z a pre-sleep header (~05:0xZ) is expected, and it is not by itself a dead poller. Killing and restarting live loops costs extra Kaggle calls (e10 = 8 calls, feed = 16 topics). A partial kill could leave two pollers or two e10 loops, doubling the API load while the ban-risk throttle is in force.
findings.evidence: lb_poll.py l.14 (timeout=180), l.20 (sleep 30 on error), l.35 (time.sleep(600)); night_checklist.md G1 ('only if no lb_poll.py process is alive') and N.4 ('the poller recovers by itself (timeout 180)'; loop restart thresholds 75 / 100 min). Live PIDs at 03:16Z: lb_poll.py 37016, e10_watch_loop.py 18040 (run_e10_watch_loop.sh 19596), run_feed_loop.sh 10924, watchdog 10576.
findings.action: At 06:07Z: restart the poller only if PID 37016 (or any lb_poll.py process) is gone, or if no new header has appeared 13 min after the wake. Restart the e10 / feed loops only past their logged age limits (75 / 100 min). After any restart, confirm exactly one process of each kind with Win32_Process. Re-arm the watchdog per R31-A2 (battery-tolerant, poll header > 25 min). 0 Kaggle calls for the check.
